title: Organic traffic ceiling
subtitle: ShareHue and SignKaro, from Google Keyword Planner and Search Console
summary: ShareHue is a niche tool with a small search market. Organic alone makes it a modest side income, not a company.
SignKaro's addressable market is about 25 times larger. If the goal is income from organic traffic, most SEO effort belongs there.
Every number here is an order of magnitude. Volumes are range midpoints because the Ads account has no spend, and Keyword Planner lists close variants as separate rows.

sections.heading: Method
numbered: Keyword Planner returned 2,400 to 6,700 keyword ideas per product and location from 10 seed terms.
Rows were removed when they name a competitor (DocuSign, Adobe, Frontify, Canva), another company's brand (Nike brand guidelines), or an unrelated task (logo makers, Google sign-in, PDF editors).
The remaining rows were grouped by topic and summed.
Ceiling = monthly searches times click share: 27% at position 1, 11% at position 3, 2.5% averaged over positions 6 to 10.
sections.note: Read position 1 as the hard upper bound and positions 6 to 10 as what a small new site reaches in its first year if it ranks for most of the cluster.

sections.heading: ShareHue
bullets: The product market is small. Every brand guideline query in the United States adds up to about 160,000 searches a month. Owning all of it at position 1 is about 43,000 visits a month.
Worldwide the cluster is four times larger. ShareHue serves English speakers everywhere, so the worldwide row is the right ceiling for product pages and the blog.
Colour tools are a different market, fifteen times larger and dominated by utility sites. Those visitors are developers and students, not buyers. Treat it as reach and links.
Competitor-branded queries (Frontify, Canva, Figma guidelines) are about 60,000 a month worldwide, which matches the thin Search Console data so far.

sections.heading: SignKaro

rows: Contract templates (rental, NDA, offer letter, deed, consent)
E-signature (sign a pdf, electronic signature, esign)

bullets: Excluded: competitor-branded searches of about 714,000 a month in the United States and 277,000 in India. Winnable only through comparison pages, and only in part.
In the United States, templates are twice the e-signature volume. In India it is the reverse: sign pdf online and its variants dominate.
Each contract type is its own cluster with 50,000 or more searches a month in both countries. The template pages are the main lever.

sections.heading: What to expect from ShareHue on organic search

rows: Month 6, if the pages below exist
Ceiling (position 1 on the whole worldwide brand cluster)

paragraphs: Assumptions: 3% of visitors on product pages sign up, 0.5% on colour tool pages, 3% of free accounts pay, and the average paying account is about $45 with the Agency plan in the mix. Churn is not included. The stock of MRR at month 12 is roughly the sum of the monthly additions minus what leaves, about $2,000 to $5,000 MRR. The ceiling row needs years and would still top out around $50,000 MRR.

sections.heading: How to earn from it organically
numbered: Sell to agencies, not brands. One Agency account is $79 and it brings its clients with it. Every handover is a demo to the client's marketing team. Lead the pricing page with the agency story.

Let the product do the marketing. Each published brand site is a landing page. A small Made with ShareHue link on Free plan sites makes every free user recruit for you. This channel scales with usage, not with Google.

Own brand guidelines template and brand guidelines examples. The template query is the largest product-intent term: about 50,000 searches a month worldwide, 5,000 in the US. Build a page that starts a site from a template without a PDF, and an examples gallery of public sites.
Use the colour tools as reach, not revenue. Put one line under each result: import your brand PDF to get the whole palette. Let the links they earn lift the product pages.

Push the AI assistant channel harder than Google. 83 of the first 93 sign-ups in the playbook's own data came from ChatGPT and assistants. ShareHue ships brand.json and brand.md. Make brand data for AI tools the lead use case.
Cut the blog to one post a day. Two posts a day on a 160,000-search market is more than the market can absorb. Spend the saved effort on the template page, the examples gallery and comparison pages.

sections.heading: Where the real money is
paragraphs: SignKaro's addressable organic market is about 25 times larger: four million searches a month in the United States alone, and a realistic first-page outcome near 100,000 visits a month per country. Each contract type is a 50,000-search cluster on its own. Most SEO effort should go to SignKaro's template and use-case pages. ShareHue should ride on agencies, the product badge and the AI channel.

sections.heading: Files
sections.note: To refresh: open Keyword Planner, enter the 10 seeds per product, set the location, download the keyword ideas CSV, and replace the file. Exact volumes appear only once the account has run a campaign.
